description: Returns du'as from a curated du'a corpus for a life context (e.g. anxiety, travel, gratitude), with source and grading where recorded. Show any crisis_resource block verbatim.

audience.description: Optional: curious, revert or practising, from the user's own self-description only. Teaching context attaches whenever an entry exists; omit when the audience is unknown.

context.description: Life context to match against. Examples: 'anxiety', 'morning', 'travel', 'forgiveness', 'gratitude'. Send this or id, not both.

id.description: A du'a id taken from a related reference in an earlier response. Send this or context, not both.

limit.description: Number of du'as to return for a context; default 3, max 10. The response says how many more exist. Ignored with id.

locale.description: Locale; defaults to "en". Du'a records are English for every locale; a crisis resource is given in the request locale, or, with no locale or "en", in the language of the crisis words (Indonesian, Urdu, Arabic or Turkish; Bengali and Persian get the English text with local helplines).

offset.description: Number of du'as to skip before the page, for paging with limit; default 0. Ignored with id, and on the bereaved set.

name: get_dua
title: get_dua
